brief:
Israel revoked the diplomatic status of Dutch envoys in response to the Netherlands imposing sanctions on West Bank settlements, Al Jazeera English reported. The move marks an escalation in tensions between the Israeli government and Western nations over illegal settlement activity in occupied Palestinian territory.

The Dutch sanctions target businesses and individuals involved in settlement expansion, part of broader Western pressure on Israel over its occupation policies. Israel's revocation of diplomatic privileges signals its determination to resist international pressure on settlement issues.
dek: Israel escalates retaliatory measures as Western sanctions target illegal West Bank settlements.
title: Israel revokes Dutch diplomats' status over West Bank settlement sanctions
